full_judgment:
A K Badrul Huq, J: By this application under Order 41 Rule 21 of the Code of Civil Procedure, the defendants-respondents-petitioners seek rehearing of the appeal being First Appeal No. 46 of 1997 on setting aside the judgment and decree dated 24.5.1999 recorded by this court allowing the appeal on reversing the judgment and decree of the trial court and thereby awarding a decree of specific performance of contract with respect to the property detailed in the schedule to the plaint in favour of the plaintiff-appellants-opposite parties. 

 2. A suit being Title Suit No. 163 of 1992 for Specific Performance of Contract laid by the plaintiff-appellants-opposite parties against the defendants-respondents-petitioners with respect to the property described in the schedule to the plaint stood dismissed by the judgment and decree dated 31.8.1996 recorded by the learned Subordinate Judge and Artha Rin Adalat No. 4 Dhaka. Feeling aggrieved of the aforesaid judgment and decree, the plaintiffs-appellants-opposite parties approached this Court in the above noted appeal. 

 3. The defendants-respondent-petitioners entered appearance in the appeal on 24.4.97 through a vokalatnama which was accepted by the learned Advocates Mr. Syed Mahbubur Rahman and Mr. Md. Shahidul Alam Chowdhury practising before this Court. Paper Book had been prepared by the plaintiffs-appellants-opposite parties and those were filed before the concerned section. Copies of the paper book had been supplied both to the appellants and the respondents on 26.4.1999. Mr. Bakhtiar Hossain, the learned Advocate for the plaintiffs-appellants-opposite parties mentioned the appeal before this Court for fixing a date of hearing. On 2.5.1999 the appeal appeared in the list as to be mentioned (উল্লেখিত হইবে) and the same was posted for hearing on 12.5.1999 at the top subject to part heard. The appeal started appearing in the list since 12.5.99 and, ultimately, it was taken up for hearing on 17.5.1999 an it was heard in part on that date. On 18.5.1999 the appeal was also heard in part and on 19.5.1999 the hearing was concluded and 24.5.1999 the appeal was fixed for pronouncement of judgment. On 24.5.1999 judgment was pronounced and the appeal was allowed without any order as to costs. Plaintiff's suit for specific performance of contract was decreed.
